name: qiongtu
description: QiongTu Windows desktop photogrammetry workspace skeleton.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @qiongtu/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @qiongtu/desktop
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @qiongtu/contracts && npm run lint --workspace @qiongtu/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @qiongtu/contracts && npm run test --workspace @qiongtu/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @qiongtu/contracts && npm run build --workspace @qiongtu/desktop
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run build && npm run smoke --workspace @qiongtu/desktop
